messages:
sophia.m: Heads up — running q4b int4 on the new model triggered a quality regression on the longprompt holdout (>=1024 tokens). Uploaded failing samples to the eval dashboard, see link.
marco: ugh, how big is the regression? numbers?
abel: can you paste the metric diff? perplexity or EM?
sophia.m: EM down ~7pt on the longprompt holdout, answer extraction F1 -5. Short prompts unaffected.
nora: do we know if this is kv cache related or attention kernel mismatch after quantization?
sophia.m: initial bisect points at attention kernel selection + int4 quant noise. Repro steps attached in the dashboard note.
eval-bot: Dashboard snapshot: https://dash.example/redsnap/1759999980 (snapshot id q4b-int4-longctx-1759) :eyes:
marco: can you run a tiny canary with cached KV disabled and with ip1 kernel fallback? quick config: 
```
MODEL=redwood-q4b
QUANT=int4
KV_CACHE=true/false
KERNEL=auto,ip1
--samples 200
```
sophia.m: will run now, starting 200-sample canary in staging, ping when done.
label-ops: if we need golden refresh, we have capacity for ~250 relabels this week. what selection criteria?
abel: pick the longtail prompts where F1 delta >3 and token length >1024, and prefer unique semantic clusters (de-dup before sending).
nora: also add any samples with tokenization mismatches — we saw tokenwalk collisions in earlier runs.
marco: note: avoid sampling from the microgolden set; those are reserved for regression gating.
sophia.m: canary done — quick look: disabling KV reduced regression by ~2pt, kernel fallback recovered another ~3pt. attaching sample IDs 2345, 2347, 2410 that still fail.
eval-bot: Can confirm: canary snapshot https://dash.example/redsnap/1759999980/canary (canary_id c-1759)
label-ops: sending 150 candidate samples to ops queue (IDs prefixed c-1759). ETA to label: 48h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
abel: plan proposal: 1) de-dup candidate set, 2) relabel 150 highest-delta samples, 3) run quant-profile tweak (scale clamps) + kernel pin for longctx, 4) run final canary 1k samples. ok?
sophia.m: +1, also add a unit test to the eval harness for longprompt exact-match checks.
marco: I'll open a small RFC for the kernel pin change and quant clamp; want prod rollback plan if perf hit.
sophia.m: thanks — I'll update the eval dashboard with sample provenance and link the relabel job. @label-ops ping when you push labels. :pray:
